decisions.reason: As a newly launched line with its own page, it likely meets or comes close to aspiration levels and a small but established firm would use available slack to keep testing it rather than withdraw it quickly.

The serum appears less strongly supported than Product A, but in a common skincare segment with plausible demand it is still worth retaining while management compares early results with aspirations and searches for adjustments short of exit.

With only limited website prominence and likely weaker differentiation, this product is the most likely to fall below aspiration levels, leading a small firm with limited slack to reallocate resources to stronger products or new development.
